faces.name: Some Disassembly Required
faces.oracleText: {B}, Sacrifice a creature: Distribute the sacrificed creature's keyword abilities among any number of other target creatures until end of turn. If it's December, you gain 1 life for each of those keywords.

faces.name: Something Worth Saving
faces.oracleText: Mill four cards. You may put a permanent card from among them into your hand. You gain 1 life. (To mill four cards, put the top four cards of your library into your graveyard.)
